overview_description.description: Cogoport is a multinational company headquartered in Singapore and has offices in India, Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia. Cogoport is an Indian unicorn, privately owned and backed by the world's most respected and renowned venture capitalists: Accel Partners and Tiger Global. Cogoport is currently in hypergrowth mode and has been named an Asia-Pacific High-Growth Company by the Financial Times and an Indian Growth Champion by the Economic Times. Cogoport has more than 1000 employees across 10 offices in India.
